prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: desktop web product interface design comp, landscape 3:2. Contemporary dispatch-panel world: graphite frame, cool white work surface, cobalt routing line, amber reserved only for exceptions, crisp sans-serif and tabular numeric labels. Protected destination is withheld until session validation. Only the product title and access-validation headline are legible; no process identifiers or personal data. Accessible contrast and visible focus; no generic SaaS cards, gradients, legal imagery, or watermark.
